source_semantics.control: AI Center toolbar exposes New session and binds it to ClearClicked, which delegates to Clear().
source_semantics.local_transition: Clear resets current content, output/error, prompt key, suggestion, elapsed time, and last approval id/status while deliberately leaving session history intact.
source_semantics.side_effects: New session is browser/session-local state only and performs no persistence, AI-provider, WordPress, queue, approval mutation, navigation, or success-receipt operation.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/ai-center-approval-status-control.tsx hosts the real AI Center local session surface and binds only the New session button to AIMW-AI-C7621E276C.
laravel_adaptation.state: The adaptation exposes source-equivalent prompt-key/current-content draft state and clears those values together with transient approval display/error/load state without claiming Generate, Submit, Copy, metadata refresh, history clearing, or navigation operations.
laravel_adaptation.stale_read_guard: A monotonically increasing read epoch invalidates an older in-flight approval-status read when New session is pressed, preventing stale asynchronous data from resurrecting cleared approval state.
laravel_adaptation.network_boundary: The New session click calls only clearSession. It sends no request, carries no body or resource ID, and has no server mutation action contract.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The control is rendered only inside the existing AI Center host when FrontendContext includes ai.use; otherwise it fails closed.

tenant_isolation.render_boundary: The AI Center host is reached through the authenticated tenant shell and authoritative /tenants/{tenant}/context contract.
tenant_isolation.cross_tenant_boundary: Focused Laravel acceptance proves an Alpha-only authenticated member receives 404 for Beta AI Center/context routes.
tenant_isolation.id_surface: The local reset accepts no tenant, approval, site, content, or other caller-supplied resource identifier and creates no direct-ID/IDOR surface.
